diagram_math_checks.data: Two-knot panel: knots 0,1 and specialized values 0,1.
diagram_math_checks.check: Verification 1.1 proves the interpolant is the affine line x for this specialization; solid segment and dashed extensions all satisfy s=x. Caption explicitly discloses the specialization so no ordering assumption on arbitrary y1,y2 is added.

On [0,1], the cubic Bezier with ideal controls (0,0),(1/3,1/2),(2/3,1),(1,1) has x=t and y=3t/2-t^3/2. On [1,2], controls (1,1),(4/3,1),(5/3,1/2),(2,0) give x=1+t and y=1-3t^2/2+t^3/2, equal to the displayed reflected piece. Horizontal control coordinates are rounded to six decimal places only for drawing, with no change to the exact authored formulas.

Differentiation gives s′=3/2-3x^2/2 and s″=-3x on [0,1]; on [1,2], s′=-3/2+3(2-x)^2/2 and s″=-3(2-x). Thus both pieces meet with s=1, s′=0, s″=-3 at x=1, and s″=0 at x=0,2, exactly as Verification 2.1. The dotted segment is horizontal at y=1.

The left tail has slope 3/2 through (0,0); the right tail has slope -3/2 through (2,0). Both match endpoint first derivatives, and their zero second derivatives match the cubic endpoint curvatures. This follows def-natural-cubic-spline and supplier theorem proof 2.1. Remarks limit tails to ambient intervals extending beyond the knots.

No new logical claims, dependencies or proof steps were introduced; the figure restates the existing formulas and Verification 1.1, 1.2, 2.1. The rigorous verification remains independent of the figure.
